name: Spec Foundation
summary: VCP-native path from idea or brief into product brief, PRD, tasks, backlog, memory, and review gates.
use_when: a new AI-assisted product or major feature needs controlled foundation before implementation
do_not_use_when: tiny local fixes already fit no-spec with validation
cli: python3 -m vcp_cli spec depth --task "describe the feature"
stop_conditions: do not treat implementation as substitute product discovery when core brief is still missing
